quests.title: Acorn Avenue Slip Sort
quests.waitingUse: Quiet one-page writing for a seated lobby wait with an adult nearby and only a pencil on the page.
quests.kidDirection: Choose three tiny errand slips, sort them by place, and write the first helpful delivery note.
quests.adultNote: Point to one real room detail for inspiration, then let the child keep answers short and quiet.

pageSections.heading: Errand Slips
lines: The first leaf slip asks for ____________________________.
The second leaf slip belongs near ____________________________.
The third leaf slip is marked with ____________________________.

pageSections.heading: Desk Clues
lines: The quiet waiting-room clue looks like ____________________________.
The clerk writes the neat label ____________________________.

quests.takeHomeLine: Save this page and finish the Acorn Avenue errand route at home.

quests.title: Button Bakery Table Map
quests.waitingUse: Low-mess restaurant table quest for a calm seated wait while food or a turn is coming.
quests.kidDirection: Draw a tiny bakery path, name the mixed-up clue, and write three clear directions.
quests.adultNote: Use the edge of the printed page as the bakery street and keep extra materials off the table.

pageSections.heading: Map Mixup
lines: The helper redraws the map with ____________________________.

pageSections.heading: Clear Directions
lines: Last, place the button tray at ____________________________.

quests.takeHomeLine: Save this map page and add one more Button Bakery stop later.

quests.title: Spoon Ferry Gate Log
quests.waitingUse: Quiet airport gate writing page for a seated family wait with one pencil and one printed sheet.
quests.kidDirection: Pick a lunchbox cargo, list three harbor stops, and write the ferry log ending.
quests.adultNote: Invite the child to borrow one color or shape from nearby seats, bags, or signs without leaving the seat.

pageSections.heading: Harbor Stops
lines: Stop one has a dock shaped like ____________________________.
Stop three needs the cargo called ____________________________.

quests.takeHomeLine: Save this ferry log and finish the harbor route after the wait.

quests.title: Pocket Park Bench Notice
quests.waitingUse: Sibling activity for a seated pickup line or lobby wait where each child can add one quiet notice.
quests.kidDirection: Fill the notice board with three small park messages and write what happens on the bench.
quests.adultNote: Let siblings suggest one short noun each, then have one child write while the page stays flat.

pageSections.heading: Notice Board
lines: The second tiny notice points toward ____________________________.
The third tiny notice asks for ____________________________.

quests.takeHomeLine: Save this page and finish the Pocket Park notice story at home.
